title: russian attack kills three near ukraines kharkiv governor says 2026 08 23
text:
Aug 24 (Reuters) - A Russian attack on ​the outskirts ‌of Kharkiv in Ukraine's northeast ​killed three ​people, the regional ⁠governor said ​on the Telegram ​messaging app late on Sunday.
Emergency services ​have ​rescued and evacuated eight ‌people, ⁠some of whom were injured, Oleh Syniehubov ​said, ​adding ⁠the search was ​ongoing to ​identify ⁠any other possible casualties.
